Actions.use_case: Discovering Cosmos DB accounts and reading their properties.
Listing and reading SQL (Core) API databases in a Cosmos DB account.
Reading client encryption keys used by Always Encrypted containers so backups capture encryption metadata.
Listing and reading containers within a SQL database.
Reading stored procedures defined on a container so they are captured in the backup.
Reading user-defined functions defined on a container so they are captured in the backup.
Reading triggers defined on a container so they are captured in the backup.
Reading database-level throughput (RU) settings to reproduce them on restore.
Reading container-level throughput (RU) settings to reproduce them on restore.
Reading existing SQL role assignments for diagnostics and idempotent grants.
Granting RSC the built-in Cosmos DB Data Reader role for data-plane backup access. Constrained by the subscription guardrail policy.
